gsr.options.title: GSR Reflections
gsr.options.enabled.tooltip: Water and glass reflections (screen space + 3D Gaussian field). With an Iris shaderpack, the pack draws the reflections itself and these settings have no effect.
gsr.options.preset.tooltip: Low / Medium / High / Ultra set the resolution, the splats per page and the uploads per frame. Picked from the GPU on first launch. Splats per page (Low: half, saves 32 MiB of video memory) apply at the next startup. Custom: values changed by hand.
gsr.options.resolution.tooltip: Resolution of the reflection. Lower is faster and blurrier; the final image is always upscaled to full resolution along depth edges.
gsr.options.strength.tooltip: Strength of reflections on water and translucent blocks (100% = physical Fresnel).
gsr.options.floor.tooltip: Reflection on upward-facing opaque blocks (grass, stone...). 0% = water and translucent blocks only.
gsr.options.roughness.tooltip: 0% = perfect mirror (calm water, sharpest and most stable). Higher values blur the reflection with per-frame noise smoothed over time.
gsr.options.distance.tooltip: Maximum distance of an off-screen reflection ray, in blocks.
gsr.options.debug_view.tooltip: Shows one stage of the reflection (not saved). Cost: red = GSR steps, green = splats read, blue = back-facing splats.
gsr.options.overlay.tooltip: Overlay with the GPU time of each pass, loaded pages and queues (not saved).
gsr.options.brick_mask.tooltip: Skips empty space inside pages. Turn off only to measure its gain (not saved).
